Aggregate an all-payer bridge result over its identified bands

Source: R/chia_medicare_bridge.R
chia_bridge_all_payer_total.Rd

Sum the identified all-payer volume and report whether every requested band resolved. The `fully_identified` flag is the hook the capacity-evidence gate keys on: an all-payer workload total is only admissible when no band was silently dropped.

Usage

chia_bridge_all_payer_total(bridged)

Arguments

bridged

The `data.frame` returned by [bridge_medicare_to_all_payer()].

Value

A list with `total` (sum of `all_payer_volume` over identified bands; `NA_real_` if none), `fully_identified` (logical: all input bands identified), `n_identified`, `n_total`, and `unidentified_bands` (the `age_lower` values that were refused).

See also

[bridge_medicare_to_all_payer()]

Other chia-medicare-bridge: bridge_medicare_to_all_payer(), chia_bridge_contract(), validate_chia_bridge_contract()

Examples

md <- data.frame(age_lower = c(65L, 75L), medicare_volume = c(400, 300))
chia_bridge_all_payer_total(bridge_medicare_to_all_payer(md))
#> $total
#> [1] NA
#> 
#> $fully_identified
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
#> $n_identified
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $n_total
#> [1] 2
#> 
#> $unidentified_bands
#> [1] 65 75
#>
